one_line: One fixed frame in a real room, with a one-line personal reason: 'instead of going out, I bring it home'.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a toddler hugs a tall box marked BLISS in a bright styled living room; a woman steps in at 0:01. Voiceover (transcript): 'בליס, אני מאוהבת בכם'. Subtitles 'בליס', then 'בליס אני מאוהבת בכם'.
q1_hook.why: A person mid-action with a branded box and a voice from frame one avoids a slow intro (H1, H6) and makes the viewer ask what is inside. But it opens with a brand love line, not a need: the brand is the first word on screen (H3), and the reason arrives at 0:09 (H2).

beats.what: Toddler hugs a BLISS box, a woman joins; 'בליס אני מאוהבת בכם'
beats.why: Brand love line over a lively scene.

beats.what: They open a big box, she unwraps foam pieces; 'באמת שכל פריט שהזמנתי'
More boxes, she lifts a round pouf; 'במקום ללכת לג'ימבורי אני מביאה את הג'ימבורי הביתה'
beats.why: The one clear reason: bring the gymboree home.

beats.what: She tips out a bag of cubes; they build cubes and a castle arch; 'נתחיל מהג'ימבורי', 'נמשיך לטירה'
beats.why: The set grows in the same frame.

beats.what: A balance beam, the toddler walks it holding her hands; a slide; 'סופר אסתטי ומתאים בסלון'
beats.why: New pieces, but the praise stays generic.

beats.what: Closer camera: stacking cubes, a tower falls at 0:34, the toddler pushes and sits on the pouf
beats.why: First change of camera, and the play finally leads.

beats.what: Mother and toddler slide down; 'ואלו הבחירות הכי טובות שלי', 'פריטים שמשתלבים לי מושלם בבית'
beats.why: Delight and the verdict arrive together.

beats.what: The mother lifts the toddler in the air; last subtitle names the child

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, no send or save ask, no comment word in the video or the caption.
q2_flow.why: A clear arc, parcel to build to play to a lift in the air, with items and positions changing every 2 to 4 s inside one frame (K2, R3). The ending is the emotional peak (R4, K1). But the child's play, the best part, only leads from 0:31, after half the Reel of unpacking and praise (R1).

q3_cta.what: None. The video ends on the lift in the air. Caption: a product line, 'הכי איכותי ויפה שיש ומתאים לי בדיוק לבית', 'כבר מכור ומשחק בו כל יום', and '@bliss.il'. No link, code or price.
q3_cta.why: The lift in the air is a clean emotional finish (E8, K1). But a parent who wants the set has no brand handle on screen, no link, no price, no place to buy (C6). No question or reason to send it either (C4, R6).

q4_shown.what: BLISS-marked boxes and foam pieces arriving 0:00 to 0:13, a round pouf at 0:10; cubes and a castle arch 0:16; a balance beam 0:21; a slide with a round tunnel 0:26; building, climbing, sliding 0:31 to 0:48. No price, no sizes.
q4_shown.why: The product is handled from 0:00 and in use throughout (S1, K5). But the brand is printed large on boxes and said in the first line, so brand share is high (H3, C7). Proof is play only: no size, material or safety information (K4). The child's face is shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: 7 shots in 51 s. The first 31 s is one fixed wide frame with time jumps every 2 to 4 s; then 6 shots of 1.5 to 9 s, closer and higher. Subtitles in short chunks. Ends on a lift.
q5_edit.why: A fixed frame with time jumps keeps the room stable while the set grows, easy to follow (E2, R3). The later closer shots add angles for the play (R3). At 51 s it is long for one demo (R2). Subtitles carry nearly every sentence (T2).

q6_topic.what: A mother and toddler unbox and build a foam play set at home instead of going out, for a rainy afternoon. Serves parents looking for home play for a toddler.
q6_topic.why: The 'instead of the gymboree, I bring it home' line is a clear everyday reason (K6), and the toddler's building and sliding gives a joyful peak (K1). 'הגשימו לי את כל החלומות' and 'כל פריט יותר יפה מהשני' are hype, not detail (K6).

q7_filmed.what: A fixed phone at eye level, wide, in a bright styled living room with large windows, later closer and from higher angles. A mother and a toddler on camera. Window light, no shake.
q7_filmed.why: A steady frame in a real room shows the set's scale and the room it fits (F7). The people and pieces are small in the wide frame (F4). The styled room and matching outfits make it read as an ad more than a creator (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: Light serif white subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, key words bold and larger, at about 83 to 88% of the frame height, following the voiceover: 'בליס' (0:00), 'בליס אני מאוהבת בכם' (0:01), 'במקום ללכת' (0:10), 'אני מביאה את הג'ימבורי הביתה' (0:12), 'סופר אסתטי ומתאים בסלון' (0:26), 'ואלו הבחירות הכי טובות שלי' (0:44). The last line includes the child's name.
q8_text.caption: 'הג'ימבורי החדש של' and the child's name. Three short lines: the product, 'הכי איכותי ויפה שיש ומתאים לי בדיוק לבית', 'כבר מכור ומשחק בו כל יום', then '@bliss.il'. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1), but sit in the bottom 35% and follow almost every sentence (T2, T4, F2). Caption opens with a product line and the child's name, no search words, no hashtags (T7). No disclosure word (T8, S7). The child's name by the face is a risk (S5).

weak_points: Generic praise; the child's name beside the face; the brand boxed and said in the first 15 s; no size, safety or price information; subtitles in the bottom band; 51 s.
lumebook_takeaway: Fixed phone, a real room, the parcel arriving and the book coming out, with one personal reason as the first line. No child needed for the unboxing.
not_verified: Whether the first 31 s are jump cuts, time-lapse or one take (items and positions change within the same frame). The account holder and whether it is paid (label 0, no disclosure seen). Music (none evident). Correction: in the first frame the toddler faces the box, so no face is visible.
